basic_info.description: Extraordinary top-floor 2 level condo. Truly unlike any other  NOPA property! With the scale and flexibility of a single-family home, this top-floor residence combines preserved Victorian elegance with modern comfort. On the main level, soaring ceilings, hardwood floors, and a grand stained glass skylit entry highlight the home's historic character, while the upper level offers an expansive modern living space.  All of this, just steps from the neighborhood's vibrant shops, restaurants, parks, and transit. 2 level top floor condo in 3 unit building. Abundant natural light. Large private rear deck with views & stainless steel BBQ. Formal living room and dining room. Updated modern bathrooms. Spacious kitchen with Mielle and Viking appliances. Grand skylit entry.  Side by side parking in the garage.
